about: Each case = documents + questions with known correct sources. gold_quotes are short exact snippets of the passage(s) that answer the question (used for retrieval recall). answer_contains / answer_contains_any are checked in the answer text. expect_abstain = the documents do NOT contain the answer. Do not tune prompts on the heldout split.
